title: Instructions & AGENTS.md
description: The system instructions are assembled at runtime from AGENTS.md, config.toml, and built-ins, then cached by a deterministic key.

steps.annotation: Instruction inputs are explicit runtime data, not a hardcoded string.
A new key causes the sections to be selected and joined.

steps.content: I follow the AGENTS.md guidance, the active model and approval policy, and the built-in tool instructions.
steps.annotation: The model sees the assembled instructions, not a static prompt.
Repeated turns avoid rebuilding identical instruction text.
